thread:
marta: Quick design check — dark console feels solid overall but two things stood out: chart series colors collapse at small sizes, and the log syntax highlighter is too neon for long reads.

jon: Agreed on charts. On small multi-series views the purple + blue have ~2.8:1 contrast between them, makes lines and bars indistinguishable when thin. Can we move toward hue separation instead of saturation? :thinking_face:

sam: For accessibility we should keep AA minimum 4.5:1 for text and 3:1 for UI components. For chart colors we usually aim for perceptual difference (~10–15 delta E or a11y contrast >= 2.5 between adjacent series).

kevin: I ran the palette through a quick script. Current tokens: `--accent-blue: #3b82f6`, `--accent-violet: #7c3aed`. If we desaturate violet to `#6b46c1` and shift blue to `#2563eb` the contrast against bg improves and separation is clearer.

aria: Throwing a Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/dark-theme-props — added proposed swaps on the charts page, and a reduced-saturation syntax theme for logs.

marta: Nice. For the syntax theme: the problem is comments and functions are both bright. We want comments muted, functions a bit brighter, keywords medium. Example patch: 

```
--syntax-bg: #060708;
--syntax-text: #d7dde1;
--syntax-comment: #7b888f; /* muted */
--syntax-keyword: #9f7aea; /* softer violet */
--syntax-fn: #60a5fa; /* function names */
```

jon: That feels readable. One nit: function blue is close to link blue. Maybe keep link blue as `--link: #1e88ff` and use `--syntax-fn: #4aa3ef` so links still pop.

sam: Also add focus/hover states for charts legend markers — keyboard highlight needs 4.5:1 against surface. Right now legend tokens on surface-elev-1 are failing.

kevin: I'll update the tokens and run the visual regression. theme-bot: please enqueue contrast checks and storybook screenshots for `design/charts` and `design/log-viewer`.

theme-bot: queued jobs: contrast-check (priority: high), storybook-snapshots (design/charts, design/log-viewer). ETA ~12m.

marta: Copy tweak: change chart tooltip header from "Series" to "Metric" — PM asked for clearer language in multi-tenant dashboards.

jon: Good call. Also rename token `--accent-violet` to `--series-2` to avoid semantic leakage.

aria: Quick accessibility test note — when zoomed to 120% the thin sparkline strokes disappear on mobile. Recommend bumping min stroke to 2px for < 48px tall charts.

sam: Filed tiny bug: https://tracker/RED-2048 — includes screenshots and contrast numbers.

marta: Thanks team. Kevin, can you post the PR link when ready? I'll review Figma afterwards and update the rollout checklist (canary to 10%). :thumbsup:

kevin: Will do. PR incoming in ~30m with token changes + storybook updates.

jon: If possible let's keep the syntax theme configurable per org (so enterprise can pick high-contrast mode). We have the plumbing in theme service already.

marta: Good idea — add opt-in toggle in Console > Preferences. I'll mock it in the next pass.

aria: End-to-end note: when we ship, let's include `--chart-palette-compact` variant that has larger hue steps for dense small multiples. Saves a lot of support tickets.

marta: Great. Closing this thread once PR link is posted. Thanks all!
